title: Edit macro
variablesTitle: Variables replaced when the macro is inserted
discardTitle: Go back to the saved values
titleHelp: The short name shown in the macro menu.
descriptionHelp: Optional Markdown text shown under the title. The menu displays only its first line.
locationHelp: User macros are available in every project on this computer. Project macros are saved in the project's .heidrun/config.json and shared with that project.
contentHelp: The text inserted into the pane when you use the macro. Variables in braces are replaced when the macro is inserted.
contentRequired: Write the content of the macro first
